Baked Cheese Prawns
By: Anncoo
Published: Sunday, June 6, 2010 - 10:12pm

Ingredients




10 mediums Large or  Fresh prawns
1 tablespoon chopped garlic
20 smalls ~30g Butter~cut to  cubes
Mozzarella cheese ~ shredded cheese

Black pepper

Preparation

1 Method: 2 With a small knife make a small slit down the centre of the curved back of the prawns. 3 Remove the black vein, rinse the prawns and dry gently with kitchen paper. 4 Line baking tray with aluminium foil and place prawns on it. 5 Sprinkle some salt on prawns, add butter, chopped garlic, shredded mozzarella cheese and black pepper on top of prawns. 6 Bake at 180C for 10-12 mins or till just cooked.
